name: docx_write
description: Create a Word .docx file from headings, paragraphs and tables. No images or custom styling.

path.description: .docx file to write, relative to the working folder

blocks.description: in order: a string (paragraph), {type: heading, text, level 1-3}, {type: paragraph, text} or {type: table, rows: [[cell]]} (first row is the header)

overwrite.description: replace the file when it exists (default false)

edge_cases: XML special characters and line breaks in text
